description: The United Nations Security Council on Tuesday extended by six months the mandate of an international security force in Haiti intended to fight powerful armed groups that have taken control of much of the country.
title: UN Security Council extends mandate of anti-gang force in Haiti into 2027

description: U.S. President Donald Trump has signed a voluntary pact with artificial intelligence companies to "self-police" the technology's development.
title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development

author: Jeremy Warren
description: Saskatoon-based drone maker Draganfly Inc. is receiving a US$10M "strategic investment" from two U.S. firms, including one linked to Donald Trump Jr., but says there are no board seats or other perks attached to the agreement.
title: Sask. drone company says no 'special rights' attached to $10M US investment linked to Trump Jr.

description: The U.S. Supreme Court on Tuesday let President Donald Trump's administration resume deporting migrants to countries other than their own without offering them the chance to show the ‌harms they may face, bolstering a tool his administration has used for rapid expulsions as part of his immigration crackdown.
title: U.S. Supreme Court says Trump can continue deportations to 3rd countries — for now

description: Hurricane Polo made a second landfall on Mexico's northwestern Pacific coast on Tuesday after drenching the southern Baja California peninsula.
title: Hurricane Polo makes 2nd landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast

author: Alexander Quon
description: Saskatchewan says it wants to have a large nuclear reactor online by 2042. It has also narrowed down the location of further study for its construction of Small Modular Reactors (SMR) to the Rafferty site near Estevan.
title: Premier Scott Moe goes big on nuclear with plans to explore 2 large nuclear reactors in northwest Sask.

author: Jeffery Tram
description: Hundreds of Stelco workers in Hamilton and Nanticoke, Ont. are facing an uncertain future after the company announced it will indefinitely idle its cold-rolled and coated operations at its Hamilton Works plant.
title: 'It's devastating': Hundreds of Stelco workers in Hamilton and Nanticoke face uncertain future due to layoffs

description: A surprise decision by the U.K.'s counterterrorism police to release five suspects on bail during an investigation into a suspected bomb plot at a U.S.-operated air force base in England has prompted questions and uncertainty about the incident.
title: British police say no explosives found in vehicles near U.S.-run base

author: Andrew Jeffrey
description: BG Fuels says it's had 10,000 litres of diesel stolen from three Mobil gas stations in Calgary, with surveillance footage suggesting the fuel was pulled directly out of underground tanks.
title: Police investigating after 10K litres of diesel stolen from 3 Calgary gas stations

author: Rukhsar Ali, Joel Dryden
description: CBC News breaks down each of the referendum questions to help voters prepare to mark the 10 ballots.
title: Everything you need to know about the 10 questions in Alberta's Oct. 19 referendum

description: U.S. forces are set to pull out from their last bases in Iraq by Wednesday, a departure celebrated as a victory by Iran and its allies who now have deep influence in the country where 4,500 Americans died during more than two decades of war.
title: U.S. forces set to leave Iraq after first arriving in 2003

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: Dennis Haskins, best known for playing principal Richard Belding on the hit sitcom Saved by the Bell, has died. His agent Jay Schachter confirmed the news to CBC News in a statement, though no cause of death was given. He was 75.
title: Dennis Haskins, Saved by the Bell's principal Belding, dead at 75

author: Jackson Weaver
description: This climate morality tale suggests that director Alejandro G. Iñárritu and his audience are engaging in the same self-satisfied ritual that got us into this real-life mess in the first place. Of using high-minded entertainment to point out, and joke about, our impending doom, as if that alone is admirable. As if that could change anything at all.
title: Digger review: Tom Cruise is fantastic, but you might hate the film

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: In a shift from what was presented in her mistrial, Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now argues there's no evidence Clancy actually killed her three children.
title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now says there's lack of evidence she killed her children

description: The death toll from rains and flooding in Thailand has risen ‌to 23, authorities said on Tuesday Waters receded from the hard-hit capital Bangkok, where its main airport operated in chaos and the government approved a multi-million aid package.
title: Heavy rains in Thailand kill 23, cause airport chaos

description: A British Columbia Supreme Court judge has ruled in favour of two harm-reduction activists convicted of drug trafficking who argued they were doing it to reduce the harms caused by toxic drugs.
title: Judge tosses drug trafficking convictions for B.C. compassion club founders after constitutional challenge

author: Ciaran Fahey
description: Berlin Marathon winner Tigst Assefa of Ethiopia "completely destroyed" her right Achilles tendon trying to regain her world record.
title: Berlin Marathon winner limped to finish line after rupturing Achilles tendon chasing world mark

author: Allison Jones
description: Ontario and the federal government have agreed to extend the national affordable child-care program in the province for another four years, but it may not live up to its signature goal — lowering parent fees to an average of $10 a day.
title: Province and feds extending affordable child-care program in Ontario, but fees stay the same

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: Deloitte Canada has shaved 20 per cent off its growth forecast for Canada's economy in 2027, citing increasingly tough conditions for consumers and businesses. The accounting firm's latest outlook comes as a new American ban on select Canadian imports took effect.
title: Deloitte Canada cuts GDP forecast by 20% as tariffs grip economy amid Trump's trade war

description: Jennifer Gaskin was acquitted of manslaughter Tuesday more than two decades after being convicted in the death of her infant son.
title: Ontario woman convicted of killing her baby in 2002 acquitted amid new medical research

description: Estonian authorities said Tuesday they have concluded that an arson attack in mid-August on a defence company that provides military vehicles to Ukraine was an act of sabotage commissioned by Russian security services.
title: Estonia blames Russia for arson at defence factory that produces vehicles Ukraine has used
LNG Canada to move forward with Phase 2 expansion project in Kitimat, B.C.

author: Jason Proctor
description: The main suspect in a brazen shooting and extortion campaign against an outspoken Surrey, B.C. radio station is suspected of playing an organizing role in connection with a series of Ontario extortions which resulted in more than 100 charges against 17 men earlier this year. Documents obtained by CBC News reveal the existence of a group called Hood 420, which has been linked with carrying out threats in
title: Inside 'Hood 420:' Bishnoi-linked gang tied to threats against B.C. radio station

author: Michelle Bellefontaine
description: The Let’s Talk Alberta motorhome makes a slow turn off Highway 2 into the parking lot of the Dunvegan Inn in Fairview, Alta., on a sunny mid-September morning.
title: Separatist group takes motorhome to northwestern Alberta to talk independence
1 in 8 cancer cases worldwide are caused by infections, study finds

author: Inayat Singh
description: Canada helped land a global agreement to protect nature in 2022. A new assessment shows how successful it's been.
title: Canada led a 2022 deal to protect the world's nature. Has there been progress since then?

author: Edzi'u Loverin
description: The family of 11-year-old Johnny Kiyawasew, who never came home from St. Francis Xavier residential school, spent decades searching for answers. Now, Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation and the University of Alberta say they're doing extensive research to uncover the stories of other children like Johnny who went to residential school but never made it home.
title: Grave of boy who vanished at residential school found decades later, First Nation looks for others like him

author: Padraig Moran
description: Almost 30 years after the death of Princess Diana, her brother, Charles Spencer, has written a new memoir about her life, her struggles and the royal institutions that were a big part of both.
title: New Princess Diana book 'not about settling scores,' says her brother, Charles Spencer

description: Ontario's condominium management regulator is investigating SIREG Management after the company told investors it could no longer guarantee rent payments, leaving some owners scrambling to collect rent directly from tenants.
title: Ontario investigates condo management company as investors scramble, tenants left confused

author: Kevin Maimann
description: The hacking group behind a massive FBI data breach says it will not publish the information it obtained, but it cannot guarantee what will happen with the data it already shared with journalists.
title: ShinyHunters hackers say they won't leak sensitive FBI data

author: Ashish Barua
description: When Ashish Barua's daughter brought home Métis beadwork, it made him realize that as a newcomer, he'd been taught virtually nothing about Indigenous history and culture.
title: What no one told me about the land that would become my home

author: Hayley Carolan
description: In total, about one quarter of the cross's 1,800 steel parts will be replaced. Its outdated lighting system will also be swapped out.
title: Why Montreal’s most iconic landmark will fade from the city skyline for 1 year
